# Dock tear-out calibration: flagship-density thresholds + matrix platform defaults

## Context

The two receipts-gated ACs retained from `#15244` (G1 dock tear-out) at its PR assembly — split per the honest-close-target discipline so the delivered leaf closes truthfully while the empirical calibration work keeps its own gates:

## Scope

1. **AC-2 (from #15244): empirical hysteresis calibration on flagship density** (20 items / 9 nodes / 6 tab nodes): the inherited 0.8/0.6 `detachThreshold`/`reattachThreshold` calibrated for false detaches + re-entry jitter ON the dock surface — never restored to an ancestral number by memory; chosen values carry their calibration receipts. Two binding inputs recorded on #15244's thread: **real input only** (the `#15243` matrix proved activation timings unmeasurable under CDP — synthesized input sustains transient activation indefinitely), and **Phoebe's threshold-pair watch** (PR #15413's review): the earned-re-entry law makes shallow-exit-immediate-return non-re-entering by design; if real users read that as "sticky," the calibration question moves to the threshold PAIR, not the arming.
2. **AC-6 (from #15244): platform defaults (acquisition/embodiment per OS) selected FROM the `#15243` matrix**, cited with the receipts — gated on the matrix's macOS column (@neo-fable-clio's `#15243`, rows 4-7 in @neo-kimi-phoebe's hands).

## Sequencing gates (why this is its own leaf)

Behind: `#15243`'s remaining rows/receipts + a real-input session (operator hands or a headed human-driven run). Not implementable from a sandbox alone — the calibration IS the human-input evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Threshold pair calibrated on flagship density with real-input receipts recorded (values may confirm 0.8/0.6 — the RECEIPT is the deliverable).
- [ ] The shallow-exit-return path exercised deliberately; perceived stickiness dispositioned as threshold-pair data (Phoebe's watch).
- [ ] Platform defaults cited from the matrix with per-OS receipts; the `DockLayoutAdapter`/host wiring consumes them as configs, not constants.

## Out of Scope

The tear-out mechanism itself (delivered: contract tier `#15407`/PR `#15408`; host tier + e2e via `#15244`'s closing PR); the matrix rows themselves (`#15243`).
